title: HYDE · Home

options.content:
HYDE HOME
PEAK250 — the battery-buffered supercharger · 63 A feed, up to 250 kW · deployed in hours
LIVE DATA

panels.title: Chargers online
panels.description:
How many chargers hold a live connection to the charging backend at this moment. Orange zero = no charger can start a session. If the backend itself cannot be reached, this shows 'backend unreachable' instead of a stale number.

This is a right-now stat: it always evaluates over the last 5 minutes regardless of the dashboard time range (a frozen historical range otherwise blanks it).

Truth states: a number = chargers connected (in the selected mode); 'backend unreachable' = the metrics scrape is actively failing; 'no metrics in this time range' = the selected window predates the collected metrics history (e.g. a frozen absolute range) — pick a relative range like Last 24 hours.

defaults.noValue: no metrics in this time range

targets.expr: (sum(ocpp_chargers_connected{mode="live"}) or vector(0)) and on() (up{job="ocpp-central-system"} == 1) or (vector(-1) and on() (up{job="ocpp-central-system"} == 0))

panels.title: Power flowing now
panels.description: Total power being delivered to cars right now — the sum of each gun’s newest power reading from the last 3 minutes. 0 kW simply means no car is drawing power at the moment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(kw_last)::numeric, 1), 0) AS "kW now" FROM (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, last(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END, ts) AS kw_last FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts > now() - interval '3 minutes' GROUP BY 1, 2) g WHERE kw_last > 0.5

panels.title: Buffer battery now
panels.description: The charger’s internal battery (one share per gun side) that tops up fast charging beyond what the grid feed alone could deliver. High = full boost capacity available; it dips while boosting a car and slowly refills from the grid afterwards. Latest reading — the charger reports it roughly every 15 minutes, even when idle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE connector_id WHEN 1 THEN 'Gun A side' WHEN 2 THEN 'Gun B side' ELSE 'Connector ' || connector_id END AS "side", round(last(value, ts))::int AS "charge" FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND measurand = 'SoC' AND location = 'Body' GROUP BY connector_id ORDER BY connector_id

panels.title: Sessions today
panels.description: Charging sessions started since midnight local time (Central European, CEST) across all chargers — regardless of the time range picked above. Test-rig sessions count too.

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), seg2 AS (SELECT *, max(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no) AS seg_end FROM seg), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, min(ts) AS start_ts, max(ts) AS end_ts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS dur_s, COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')) AS kwh, max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS peak_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS avg_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts >= seg_end - interval '2 minutes') AS tail_kw, count(*) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS n_power, max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes' AS is_live FROM seg2 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) SELECT count(*)::int AS "sessions today" FROM sessions WHERE start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm'

panels.title: Energy today
panels.description: Energy delivered by sessions started since midnight local time (CEST), from the chargers’ own energy meters. A session still running contributes what it has delivered so far.

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), seg2 AS (SELECT *, max(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no) AS seg_end FROM seg), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, min(ts) AS start_ts, max(ts) AS end_ts, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (max(ts) - min(ts))) AS dur_s, COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')) AS kwh, max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS peak_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS avg_kw, avg(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts >= seg_end - interval '2 minutes') AS tail_kw, count(*) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Power.Active.Import') AS n_power, max(ts) > now() - interval '3 minutes' AS is_live FROM seg2 GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(kwh)::numeric, 1), 0) AS "kwh today" FROM sessions WHERE start_ts >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm'

panels.title: The business case — measured, last 30 days
Peak power delivered (30 d)
panels.description: Highest power delivered to a vehicle in the last 30 days, measured at the gun. The PEAK250 is rated up to 250 kW.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END)::numeric, 0) AS "kW" FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Peak grid draw (30 d, measured)
panels.description: Measured at the inlet: the charger's VWGC.ChargingStationCurrentImport vendor reading, polled every 60 s. Encoding verified empirically: raw value = 100000 + watts (idle floor ≈ 30–50 W of standby electronics, 0 W during the firmware reboot, peaks 40.1 kW vs the 43.6 kW feed ceiling, sustained refill matching the ΔSoC estimate of 34.9–39.2 kW). Series exists from 2026-07-22 21:41 UTC onward. This is the demand-charge (effektavgift) KPI as the meter saw it; the ΔSoC-derived estimate remains on HYDE · Operations for comparison.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((max(GREATEST(value - 100000, 0)) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "peak grid draw" FROM meter_samples WHERE connector_id = 0 AND measurand = 'VWGC.ChargingStationCurrentImport' AND NOT is_sim AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Grid leverage (30 d)
panels.description:
DERIVED ESTIMATE — the battery-buffer effect in one number: the highest power delivered to a car in the last 30 days ÷ the 43 kW (63 A) nominal grid connection of this PEAK330-class unit. 3.4× means a car charged 3.4 times faster than the grid feed alone could sustain — the buffer supplied the rest. Method: max in-session Power.Active.Import ÷ 43 kW; the live-measured refill ceiling (~43.6 kW) confirms the 43 kW basis.

This is the PEAK250 promise, measured on site: a 63 A grid feed delivering up to 250 kW (rated) at the guns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MW' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) / 43.0)::numeric, 1) AS "grid leverage" FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND measurand = 'Power.Active.Import' AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: Sessions (30 d)
panels.description: Charging sessions in the last 30 days (gap-split sessionization, same method as the Sessions dashboard).

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')) AS kwh FROM seg GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) SELECT count(*)::int AS "sessions" FROM sessions

panels.title: Energy delivered (30 d)
panels.description: Total energy delivered to vehicles in the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')) AS kwh FROM seg GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(kwh), 0)::numeric, 0) AS "kWh" FROM sessions

panels.title: Charging revenue (30 d, est.)
panels.description: DERIVED ESTIMATE: 30-day delivered energy × the configured tariff (4.99 SEK/kWh incl. VAT, as polled from the charger). Update the constant if the tariff changes.

targets.rawSql: WITH samp AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, ts, measurand, unit, value, CASE WHEN ts - lag(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts) > interval '15 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_seg FROM meter_samples WHERE NOT is_sim AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'), seg AS (SELECT *, sum(new_seg) OVER (PARTITION BY charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS seg_no FROM samp), sessions AS (SELECT charge_point, connector_id, transaction_id, seg_no, COALESCE(max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand = 'Energy.Active.Import.Register'), max(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register') - min(value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kWh' THEN 1 WHEN unit = 'MWh' THEN 1000 ELSE 0.001 END) FILTER (WHERE measurand LIKE 'Energy.Active.%.Register')) AS kwh FROM seg GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4) SELECT to_char(round((COALESCE(sum(kwh), 0) * 4.99)::numeric, 0), 'FM999 999 999') || ' kr' AS "revenue" FROM sessions

options.content:
### Dashboards

**[HYDE · Overview](/grafana/d/hyde-overview)** — the stakeholder view: today, the last 30 days, and the grid advantage

**[HYDE · Operations](/grafana/d/hyde-operations)** — service health, faults, commands, tariff, firmware & connector wear

**[HYDE · Sessions](/grafana/d/ocpp-sessions)** — every charging session in engineering detail

**[HYDE · Registry](/grafana/d/ocpp-registry)** — OCPP protocol counters, raw telemetry, logs & traces

**[HYDE · OCPP Messages](/grafana/d/ocpp-messages)** — the charger's OCPP conversation, human-readable and filterable

*Times shown in your browser's timezone. All dashboards default to LIVE hardware data; use each dashboard's `mode` picker to view simulator/test data.*

### Housekeeping

- **Live hardware:** A2111LHE0212606001 — our **PEAK250**, the dual-gun battery-buffered supercharger (63 A grid feed, up to 250 kW delivered, deployed in hours). Everything else is classified as simulation and hidden by default.
- **Data coverage:** session & meter history since Jul 14 · ops metrics keep a durable 7-day window (since Jul 23) · grid draw is **measured at the inlet** every minute since Jul 22, alongside the buffer-physics estimate.
- **Firmware:** ZD-SW4.2.4.1 installed over-the-air Jul 23. The update reset the vendor's plug-cycle wear counters (previously 91 / 54).
- **Faults** survive restarts (durable fault log) and surface on Operations → Faults & errors with vendor detail.
- **Windows are stated:** panels say which time window they cover in their title or header tag; “no metrics in this time range” means the selected window predates collected history — pick a relative range like *Last 24 hours*.
- **Charge-point ids stay off metrics** (cardinality rule); they live on traces, logs and the session store.

description: HYDE landing page: live summary, dashboard directory and housekeeping notes. Served as the Grafana home dashboard.
